head: 5c85e4615c33d803e84032b0b9aa7b9e2bb240c4
network: internal Docker network, no Internet route
checks: enrollment: operator IPC issued P-256 and Ed25519 client certificates from CSRs; components, duplicate and reserved (bridge client ID) enrollments refused
LAN discovery: a UDP broadcast to 172.20.255.255 found the gateway at 172.20.0.2 with its CA fingerprint and endpoints; a short (amplifying) probe got no reply

discovery: HTTPS with mutual TLS; the gateway certificate verifies for the detected address and gateway.test only; the document names the CA, endpoints and the client's certificate, and carries the device key's signed binding of that CA (Ed25519 Sui personal message, verified independently with openssl)
MQTT between two LAN clients through the gateway: Python ssl (P-256) published at QoS 1, mosquitto_sub (libmosquitto/OpenSSL, Ed25519) received it
LAN client <-> component: an authorized LAN publish reached a component through the bridge; a component publication reached the LAN client's authorized subscription

denial: no client certificate and an untrusted self-signed one fail the handshake; a foreign client ID gets CONNACK 5 and MQTT 5 CONNACK 1; an unauthorized filter gets SUBACK 0x80 beside a granted one; an unauthorized publish ends the session and reaches nobody; the broker is not reachable from the LAN
wills: an authorized will was published by the broker when a LAN client vanished without DISCONNECT
revocation: the live session ended 1.0 s after the revoke without its will being published; reconnect and HTTPS refused (403 revoked)

rotation: a new certificate issued over HTTPS works at once; the old one connected during the 5 s grace, its live session ended after 5.2 s, then it was refused (superseded); rotating again within the minimum interval was refused

restart: the CA and registry persisted; the rotated certificate connects, the superseded and the revoked ones stay refused. A persistent session resumed under the same policy; after the policy changed it restarted clean, so a subscription the new policy refuses delivered nothing

offline: with the chain simulator stopped (daemon sync failing) the gateway still authenticated and authorized LAN clients; a 60 s certificate's live session ended -0.0 s from its expiry and it could not reconnect
